CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

2. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

4. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

5. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

8. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   B. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Handball.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

10. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. D — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — The speed of the music

10. C — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Components of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drawing and Painting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Swimming; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
